headline: Names a post office building in Chisholm, Minnesota after former congressman James L. Oberstar.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 14 3rd Avenue, NW, in Chisholm, Minnesota, as the "James L. Oberstar Memorial Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, rules, or funding.
when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was enacted on July 20, 2015.
